exposure: interval between pregnancies less than six months
pregnancy resulting from in vitro fertilization
cohort: The study included 1,193 puerperal women who were users of health insurance plans, recruited from five maternity hospitals.
finding: The study identified several significant risk factors for prematurity including previous preterm birth, oligohydramnios, diabetes mellitus prior to pregnancy, twin pregnancy, autoimmune disease, stress during pregnancy, urinary infection, placenta previa, pre-eclampsia, gestational bleeding, short interpregnancy interval, and pregnancy resulting from in vitro fertilization.
